# Aiden Kuemmerle | Engineering Portfolio

> Aiden Kuemmerle is an engineering student at the University of British Columbia. This portfolio covers mechanical design, CAD, prototyping, simulation, and engineering software.

Public portfolio pages are available for search and AI-assisted summaries under [robots.txt](https://kuemmerle.dev/robots.txt). The contact form is intended for people to submit directly.

## Portfolio

- [Homepage](https://kuemmerle.dev/): Background and engineering interests.
- [Standalone Projects](https://kuemmerle.dev/projects/): Completed engineering systems and detailed write-ups.
- [Quick Side Quests](https://kuemmerle.dev/quick/): Small builds, tools, CAD experiments, and prototypes.
- [Under Construction](https://kuemmerle.dev/construction/): Active projects and development milestones.
- [BeamNG.cad case study](https://kuemmerle.dev/construction/beamng-cad/): A repeatable SolidWorks-to-BeamNG vehicle simulation workflow for UBC Baja SAE.
- [Résumé](https://kuemmerle.dev/resume/): One-page co-op résumé with PDF links.
- [Sitemap](https://kuemmerle.dev/sitemap.xml): Canonical URLs for published pages.
